rules.summary: Five additive, clearance-free access labels that govern export and, on one runtime, an optional read deny; defaults come from structure.json lanes.
State assumptions before acting, touch only what the goal requires, define success up front and verify before claiming done.
Authored delegation policy: planning tiers, profiles as logical tier labels, task catalog, tool profiles, and floors that bind only when delegation is mandatory.
Terminal presentation: answer first, form matched to content, plan and result shapes, prose questions, honest empty states.
End-of-session checklist over the configured lanes: verify, commit or park, update docs, file records and decisions, synthesize knowledge, no orphans.
Shared-tree etiquette, the main-only and branches modes selected by structure.json, the size guard, and the commit format.
Hooks are bounded, read-only, network-free, stateless, exit 0 with a JSON decision, and climb the enforcement ladder only on evidence.
Exhaust the configured lanes in order (knowledge, decisions, docs, records, journal) before any external lookup; the hook is a reminder, not a gate.
Which lane each kind of information belongs in, the four-layer test, and the working, standing, promoted, superseded maturity vocabulary.
Never save over a formatted spreadsheet with openpyxl; the guard hook denies the pattern at the shell boundary.
Truth over punch in educational content and no em-dashes in generated prose.
Deterministic links, the twelve mechanical tells, prose floors, exact phrasing, title quality, and soft-wrapped paragraphs.
Secrets live only in gitignored local stores; configs reference names; environment.json declares topology without values; rotate on any commit.
